name: Shape-Memory Alloys & Polymers
summary: Explains the martensitic transformation behind shape memory and superelasticity, and how SMAs and SMPs are designed into actuators, medical devices and morphing structures.

topics.name: Thermoelastic martensitic transformation and transformation temperatures
Shape-memory effect: one-way and two-way memory
NiTi (Nitinol): processing, composition sensitivity and training
SMA actuators: wires, springs and heating/cooling bandwidth
Applications: medical stents, aerospace morphing structures, deployable space mechanisms
